profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer - Ortho Clinical Solutions at Stryker
profile.summary: Software engineer who has insatiable appetite to learn and work with innovative, cutting edge technology.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer utilizing Tcl/Tk, C, and C++ to design, develop, and maintain the Total Knee, Partial Knee, and Total Hip software applications  as part of robotic-assisted orthopedic solutions:
- Involved in code peer review process as part of quality system initiatives.
- Participated in test drive development ensuring unit tests are written before features are implemented. 
- Participated in agile process by collaborating in story definition, release and iteration planning, and estimation activities (i.e. planning poker). 
- Investigated and applies fixes for defects found within applications. 
- Collaborated with other departments to provide in-house software solutions related but not limited to verification, validation, feasibility, and usability activities. 
- Actively participated in all phases of the software development life cycle working on feasibility, requirements gathering and review, system design, implementation, verification, and validation.

positions.title: Application System Engineer
positions.description:
System engineer involved in the feasibility, analysis, documentation and testing related to the integration of system components for the Total Knee, Partial Knee, and Total Hip robotic-assisted orthopedic solutions: 
- Collaborated in the design of system features for the application software, robotic platform, implants, and surgical instruments.  
- Developed system and sub-system specifications ensuring proper traceability up to customer requirements and down to verification/validation documentation. 
- Collaborated on the troubleshooting of the systems aspects of features implemented and proposed solutions. Executed assigned systems protocols and wrote test results reports. Participated in design reviews and verification report reviews.
- Involved in risk mitigation activities during feasibility and design phases. 
- Drafted and executed system level integration verification/validation protocols and reports.

positions.title: Biomedical Engineer-Research
positions.description: Responsible for documenting and collecting data from animal studies and human subjects on research projects. Assisted in the development of new research protocols. Ensured data integrity of clinical databases. Provided day-to-day biomedical research support to the Cardiovascular Surgery department.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: Worked with evaluation and analysis team as they discovered and developed pattern recognition algorithms with regards to biometrics of varying fidelity levels. Aided in executing program objectives, ensuring timely and accurate deliveries of planned deliverables, establishing detailed technical tasks, schedules, and deadlines.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Collaborated on a project which set out to use real-time fMRI biofeedback in conjunction with acupuncture therapy to reduce chronic pain. Analyzed fMRI data using pattern recognition algorithms to elucidate activation patterns during brain states.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Aided in the design and development of a novel islet cell counting system. Programmed motors for control pinch manifold. Helped design and assemble a plethora of machines used by researchers studying diabetes.
